data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2017 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,830.6m. During 2017 the Syndicate recorded a net release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 39.4m (a ~2.2% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding), arising predominantly in the Energy and Marine divisions and attributed to favourable claims development. The 2017 year also included significant current-year catastrophe exposure (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexican earthquakes and California wildfires) with a combined current estimated ultimate of GBP 314.8m gross (GBP 102.8m net, reducing to GBP 99.3m after reinstatement premium effects). Prior-year named events referenced include the 2016 Fort McMurray wildfire and the 2016 North Canterbury earthquake.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the technical reserves movement (release of GBP 39.4m) are explicitly stated in the Technical Reserves and Movement notes. The claims development triangle and named-event amounts are present in the notes but OCR/scan quality required manual transcription. A Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) transaction concerning the 2015 UK division is discussed in the report (subsequent event) and may affect comparatives; users should be aware of potential distortions related to RITC when using development triangles. LOB-level amounts for the prior-year release are not quantified in the note (the release is attributed qualitatively to Energy and Marine).
